title: Survivor bracket jump
meaning: Federal tax on the first single-filed survivor year's MAGI computed as Single minus the same income computed as married filing jointly, deflated to today's dollars.

title: Batch cumulative tax objective
meaning: Adapter sum of each evaluated projection year's tax plus penalties.
transformations: For objective=cumulative_tax, reduce YearResult.tax + YearResult.penalties across projection years.

title: Batch ending traditional balance objective
meaning: Adapter sum of ending balances for traditional accounts in each evaluated candidate.
transformations: For objective=ending_trad, select the final year's balances and sum entries whose candidate account type is traditional.

title: MCP scenario ending-estate delta
meaning: Adapter-computed Plan B minus Plan A ending after-tax estate.
transformations: Subtract a.endingAfterTaxEstate from b.endingAfterTaxEstate.

title: Scenario comparison cell (baseline, proposal, change)
meaning: For each compared scenario metric, the baseline plan's value, the proposal plan's value and the change (proposal minus baseline, null when either side has no comparable value); the metric's own family says what the value is.

surfaces.selector: Baseline, Proposal and Change columns of every MetricTable (formatMetricValue, formatScenarioDelta) and of the annual ledger comparison

notes: Money metrics are nominal dollars; the depletionYear and projectionEndYear cells carry years, the IRMAA tier-year and simulation-count cells carry counts, and the risk cells carry probabilities (formatScenarioDelta prints the change in percentage points). safeNumber rejects non-finite values and normalizes -0. The MCP compare_scenarios delta is the adapter family mcp-compare-ending-after-tax-estate-delta, computed from two independent summaries, not from this type.

title: Cash-flow line amounts (nominal plan dollars)

surfaces.selector: YearCashFlowDialog DetailTable columns Amount, Requested, Funded, Unfunded, Debit and Credit (through display-dollar-basis-conversion)
Sankey links and per-node totals (the UI mapping is cash-flow-line-amount)
detailCsv.ts columns nominalAmount, requested, funded, unfunded, debit, credit (unrounded nominal plan dollars)

notes: Every use line satisfies requested = funded + unfunded and every transfer's debit equals its credit at the reconciliation tolerance. The line kind names the ledger term (wages, settled tax, Roth conversion, ...) whose per-year family already lists the line as a cash-flow-drilldown surface; this family is the line-level amount the drilldown prints.

title: Cash-flow line tax character amount
meaning: The dollar amount of one tax characterization attached to a cash-flow line or standing alone (ordinary income, capital gain or loss, QCD exclusion, phantom OID and the other closed kinds); metadata that is never summed into the money identities.

engineSource.symbol: YearCashFlowTaxCharacter.amountPlanDollars (on source, transfer and standalone taxCharacterMetadata lines)

surfaces.selector: YearCashFlowDialog DetailTable 'Tax character' column (kind and amount per line) and the taxCharacter view rows

notes: no registry record: the characterization is assigned by the ledger sites in simulate.ts that publish each line; the governing law sits on the upstream tax calculators (ordinary income, capital gains, QCD exclusion). capitalGain may be negative for a realized loss; other kinds are nonnegative.
